input.subject: Outcome needed – Blocked toilet, Flat 3, 15 Willowmere Road, Alderwick ZZ3 2ZZ (Ref R/PM002-1)
input.body:
Dear Riverside Works,

Re: Blocked toilet at Flat 3, 15 Willowmere Road, Alderwick, ZZ3 2ZZ (Ref R/PM002-1), tenant Noah Turner.

Our records show a visit was arranged for after 10:30 am to remove the toilet and clear the blockage by the pan connector. Our confirmation said "tomorrow after half ten (08/08/2026)", so the date may have been the 8th or the 9th. We have had no update since.

Please reply to tell us:
- whether you attended, and on what date
- whether the blockage has been cleared and the toilet refitted and working
- if the job isn't finished, what is still to do, the cost if a quote is needed, and when you can return

As in our original instruction, please send a quote and wait for our approval before doing any extra work.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings Maintenance

input.subject: Update on your blocked toilet – Flat 3, 15 Willowmere Road (Ref R/PM002-1)
input.body:
Dear Noah,

Re: Blocked toilet at Flat 3, 15 Willowmere Road, Alderwick, ZZ3 2ZZ (Ref R/PM002-1).

We're checking on the visit from Riverside Works that was arranged for after 10:30 am. Could you reply to let us know whether they came and whether your toilet is now working? If it isn't, please tell us whether you have another working toilet in the flat, so we can judge how urgent it is.

Until it's fixed, please don't flush the blocked toilet, so it doesn't overflow.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings Maintenance
